plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Ashland University '4-YEAR PLAN for the BACHELOR OF SCIENCE MAJOR in CRIMINAL JUSTICE' (B.S. in Criminal Justice, Comprehensive Major; Traditional and ONLINE; Four-Year Curriculum Guide AY 25/26, rev. 7/25; Department of Criminal Justice and Sociology). 8 semesters x 15 credits = 120 credits. Placeholder slots (CORE, CJ ELEC, MINOR, ELECTIVE, CJ OPTION) are choice:true with the guide's own slot labels as codes and catalog-worded choice_notes; the Institutional Core course list is in the catalog (see 'List of Institutional Core Courses'). Catalog typo documented: Year 4 Fall prints 'MINOR Minor Course (6)' and Year 4 Spring also prints 'MINOR Minor Course (6)' (the (5) numbering is skipped) — transcribed verbatim; credit sums reconcile (6 minor slots x 3 = 18-hour minor, 120 total). Prereqs are not stated on the 4-year guide and are therefore omitted; course-level prereqs live in the catalog course descriptions. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school, no published TCCNS/articulation). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
